# My OpenCode × DeepSeek Config

[简体中文](README.md) | **English**

**OpenCode v2 × DeepSeek Optimal Config** — a configuration scheme that keeps a single model, `deepseek/deepseek-flash`, and splits agent roles by thinking tier within OpenCode v2's multi-agent framework. Core philosophy: **token efficiency first — the best development results at the lowest context cost**.

## Current Configuration Overview

- Default primary agent: `orchestrator`
- Sole model: `deepseek/deepseek-flash` (V4.1 Flash, natively multimodal); agents differ only by thinking tier — default (thinking off) / `#low` / `#high` / `#max`
- Agent nesting: `experimental.subagent_depth: 2` (v2-native key; the v1 top-level `subagent_depth` is dropped by v2 and no longer written. Exactly covers the deepest chain in use, `orchestrator → light-orchestrator → oracle`; every other subagent is denied delegation, so a deeper level only widens the token-amplification surface)
- Session sharing: off (`share: "disabled"`)
- Permission baseline: `read` allowed by default, `shell` set to `ask` (unmatched commands go to a human; dangerous patterns are not enumerated); sensitive `.env`-type files `deny`; external directories `ask`; read-only agents get shell rules (deny all by default + allow read-only subcommands only)
- Context compression: **built-in compaction only** (opencode.jsonc) — `limit.input` declares the working window, and it fires at `limit.input − compaction.buffer` (`131072−16000=115,072` tokens), keeping a verbatim tail of `keep.tokens: 12000`; `compaction.background: false` (the v2.3.1+ switch, default `true`) avoids paying for a pre-written summary that is never used; the v1 spellings (`prune`/`tail_turns`/`reserved`/`preserve_recent_tokens`) do nothing on v2 and were removed (the v1 `reserved` maps to v2 `buffer`); no third-party compression plugin
- Global rules: `AGENTS.md` (core principles, task rejection contract, self-verification, anti-patterns, etc.; context/token discipline in `AGENTS.md`)
- Skills: **24** `SKILL.md` skills under `skills/`, loaded on demand via the native `skill` tool; each agent then trims the roster with a `skill` permission allowlist (the roster's name+description is an **always-on** per-turn cost, so it is kept minimal by role)
- Commands: **18** shortcut commands (agent routing / operations / inline / spec), see below
- Plugins: `superpowers` only (git URL pinned to tag `#v7.0.2`, loaded via the v2-native `plugins` array) — pure skill injection with **no model-mapping capability**, so model routing happens only at the agent layer (the skill → agent → tier table lives in `AGENTS.md`'s Plugins section); the pin keeps the prefix byte-stable and prevents drift from auto-updates. Task sub-sessions receive no bootstrap injection, so delegation chains don't pay that always-on cost.

## DeepSeek Model Configuration

### Prerequisites

- OpenCode v2 (desktop app's bundled CLI **2.3.2**, verified 2026-11-18; 1.18.x and older are **no longer supported**)
- **Runtime caveat**: the `opencode` on `PATH` (WinGet install) is **1.18.4**, not this config's runtime — it takes the V1→V2 migration path. For headless runs use the desktop app's bundled CLI (path in the Install and Start ⚠️ note)
- DeepSeek API key: request one at [platform.deepseek.com/api_keys](https://platform.deepseek.com/api_keys)
- Background subagents (since v2.3.0 every `task` delegation **always runs in the background**: the call returns a `sessionID` immediately and the child reports back to the parent when idle); no environment variable is needed — the old `OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_BACKGROUND_SUBAGENTS` flag is obsolete

### Option 1: Interactive TUI Setup (Recommended)

```bash
opencode
# In TUI enter: /connect → select DeepSeek → paste API Key
# Then: /models → select deepseek-flash
```

The API key is automatically persisted to `~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json`.

### Option 2: Environment Variable

Windows PowerShell:
```powershell
$env:DEEPSEEK_API_KEY="sk-your-key-here"
opencode
```

Permanent setup: add `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` to your system environment variables.

### Provider Configuration Reference

```jsonc
{
  "model": "deepseek/deepseek-flash"
}
```

This config keeps only `deepseek-flash` and splits thinking at the `providers` layer with **variants**: the default tier disables thinking and pins `temperature: 0` (fastest, cheapest), while the three non-default variants `#low`/`#high`/`#max` turn thinking on and set `settings.reasoningEffort` to `low`/`high`/`max`. `deepseek-flash` is the merged V4.1 Flash model — the former text-only and vision variants are now one natively multimodal model, so it declares `capabilities` (image input). Example (v2-native keys):

```jsonc
"providers": {
  "deepseek": {
    "models": {
      "deepseek-flash": {
        "body": {
          "thinking": { "type": "disabled" },
          "temperature": 0
        },
        "capabilities": {
          "tools": true,
          "input": ["text", "image"],
          "output": ["text"]
        },
        "variants": [
          { "id": "low",  "settings": { "reasoningEffort": "low" },  "body": { "thinking": { "type": "enabled" } } },
          { "id": "high", "settings": { "reasoningEffort": "high" }, "body": { "thinking": { "type": "enabled" } } },
          { "id": "max",  "settings": { "reasoningEffort": "max" },  "body": { "thinking": { "type": "enabled" } } }
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

> `thinking`/`temperature` must live under `body`: `settings` carries provider options only (`timeout`/`chunkTimeout`/`reasoningEffort`, …), and keys placed there are silently dropped.

> **Model ID naming convention**: `provider_id/model_id`, with variants as a `#` suffix. This repo has exactly `deepseek/deepseek-flash`, `deepseek/deepseek-flash#low`, `deepseek/deepseek-flash#high`, and `deepseek/deepseek-flash#max`.

### v2-native keys (the only dialect this repo writes)

This repo is an **OpenCode v2-only config** and writes only v2-native keys: `plugins` (not `plugin`), `providers`/`models` (not `provider`), `agents`/`commands` (not `agent`/`command`), `permissions` (ordered `{action, resource, effect}`, not `permission`; the action names are `shell`/`subagent`, not `bash`/`task`), `media.image` (not `attachment`), nesting depth as `experimental.subagent_depth`, and compaction as `{auto, background, keep, buffer}` (`background` is the v2.3.1+ switch; `prune`/`tail_turns`/`reserved` are v1 spellings v2 does not read). If any v1 trigger key appears (`provider`/`agent`/`command`/`plugin`/`permission`/`tools`/`attachment`/`small_model`, …), v2.3.2 migrates it per key and merges the result with the native keys (while `logLevel`/`server`/`layout`/top-level `subagent_depth` are dropped with a diagnostic) — no error, but the config that actually runs no longer matches what this document describes.

> `$schema` stays `https://opencode.ai/config.json` (the URL the v2 app itself writes).

## Install and Start

```powershell
# 1. Clone
git clone https://github.com/znlgis/my-opencode-deepseek-config.git

# 2. Point opencode at this repo's config directory (current session)
$env:OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR = "D:\path\to\my-opencode-deepseek-config\opencode"

# 3. API key (or run /connect in the TUI after launch)
$env:DEEPSEEK_API_KEY = "sk-your-key-here"

# 4. Start
opencode
```

Permanent (Windows):

```powershell
[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR", "D:\path\to\my-opencode-deepseek-config\opencode", "User")
```

Linux / macOS: append `export OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR="$HOME/path/to/my-opencode-deepseek-config/opencode"` to `~/.bashrc` or `~/.zshrc`.

**Alternative**: symlink `opencode/` into the global config path — on Windows (admin required) `New-Item -ItemType SymbolicLink -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.config\opencode" -Target "<repo>\opencode"`, on Linux/macOS `ln -s <repo>/opencode ~/.config/opencode`.

Three self-checks after launch: `/models` shows `deepseek/deepseek-flash`; the agent list has all 12 custom agents; describe any task in plain language and `orchestrator` classifies and routes it (to skip routing, use `/quick`, `/deep`, `/review`, … directly).

> **⚠️ Must run on OpenCode V2.x**: the `opencode.exe` on `PATH` is the WinGet install of **v1.18.4**, while the runtime actually in use is the desktop app **v2.3.2** and its bundled CLI `"$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\@opencode-aidesktop\resources\opencode-cli.exe"`. Launching under v1 takes the V1→V2 migration path, and none of the routing, permission, compaction or roster behavior described here holds; for headless runs use that CLI.

After editing repo files, sync them (`~/.config/opencode` is an independent copy, not a symlink):

```powershell
.\scripts\sync-config.ps1              # -Src overrides the source directory
```

The sync excludes `node_modules`/`.git`/package manifests and lockfiles; stale-file cleanup inside `skills/` and `agents/` is driven by the git index plus full history, so a `git rm`-staged deletion is removed from the global directory even before it is committed.

## Model Division of Labor

**Why `deepseek-flash` is the only model** (the config was consolidated right after opencode v2 went GA):

- **Everyday development is not bounded by the model's ceiling.** Reading code, editing files, running tests, writing docs, reviewing a diff — these want speed, reliability and low unit cost, not maximum reasoning. Paying pro rates for them buys no matching output.
- **Flash is where every vendor is concentrating investment.** Competition is clustered at this tier, so capability at a given price is still climbing fast; pinning the config to flash means riding the fastest-moving curve.
- **Pro's capability and price both overshoot daily work.** It serves a minority of hard problems, while a config pays for every ordinary call — keeping a pricier model resident for the occasional hard task is the wrong cost structure.
- **When more reasoning is needed, the same model supplies it via a thinking tier.** `#high`/`#max` deepen reasoning through reasoning tokens: cost is incurred per task and grows linearly at the output rate, with no second price sheet and no second cache prefix.
- **The trade-off is stated, not hidden: ceiling in exchange for cost.** On extreme problems flash may need one more round or an escalation to `#high` or even `#max` instead of landing in one shot — and that cost falls on a minority of tasks rather than taxing every ordinary call.

This repo uses exactly **one model**, `deepseek/deepseek-flash`, and introduces no other model. Agents differ along a single dimension — the **thinking tier** — expressed as model variants:

| Tier | Model reference | Mechanism | Typical agents |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cheap (trivial) | `deepseek/deepseek-flash` | body `{"type":"disabled"}` + `temperature: 0` | `orchestrator`/`explore`/`librarian`/`vision` |
| Low (routine) | `deepseek/deepseek-flash#low` | thinking on + `settings.reasoningEffort: low` | `light-orchestrator`/`consultant`/`ui-builder` |
| Deep | `deepseek/deepseek-flash#high` | thinking on + `settings.reasoningEffort: high` | `planner`/`deep-worker`/`solo` |
| Top (escalation) | `deepseek/deepseek-flash#max` | thinking on + `settings.reasoningEffort: max` | `oracle`/`reviewer` (escalation-only, read-only) |

Thinking strength is driven by two **request parameters**, both declared at the **model layer** in `opencode.jsonc`; agents only choose a model reference and write no thinking parameters at all:

- **thinking toggle** — `{"thinking":{"type":"enabled"|"disabled"}}`, a **request BODY field**. The default tier is off (cheapest); `#low`/`#high`/`#max` turn it on.
- **thinking effort** — `{"reasoning_effort":"low"|"high"|"max"}`, driven by the **provider setting** `settings.reasoningEffort` (camelCase in config, snake_case on the wire) — the only path the aisdk layer turns into `reasoning_effort`.

> **Checked against the official guide (2026-11-18, `guides/thinking_mode`)**: ① thinking is **on by default with effort `high`** — so only the default tier (explicit `disabled`) actually saves reasoning tokens: `#high` merely spells out the default, `#low` is the only rung below it, and `#max` is the only rung above it. There is no medium effort: `minimal`→low, `medium`/`xhigh`→high, `max`/`ultra`→max. ② Thinking mode **does not support** `temperature`/`presence_penalty`/`frequency_penalty` — passing them raises no error and has no effect, so the `temperature: 0` in the table binds only on the default tier while `#low`/`#high`/`#max` inherit it inertly. ③ `top_p` is the opposite: on `deepseek-flash` it applies only with thinking on (valid range 0.95–1.0, values below are treated as 0.95), and is pinned to 1.0 with passed values ignored when thinking is off — so this config sets no `top_p`. ④ When a request carries `tools`, every historical `reasoning_content` must be sent back or the API returns 400; opencode forces the replay for all deepseek models (`requireReasoning` in `ai/src/protocols/openai-chat.ts`), so nothing extra is needed here.

> **⚠️ Spelling trap (measured 2026-10-16)**: `thinking`/`temperature` under `settings` are inert (the openai-chat protocol implements no such option), and `reasoningEffort` under an agent's `options` is inert too (`options` only reaches `request.body`, and camelCase is not the `reasoning_effort` the API reads). Both must live at the **model layer**: the toggle in `body`, the effort in `settings`. Before the fix flash ran with thinking on all along, paying reasoning tokens on every step.

**Cost structure**: all four tiers share flash's single price sheet (in 0.15 / out 0.60 / cache_read 0.003 USD per 1M, off-peak) — no model premium. A tier difference shows up only in the **number of reasoning tokens**, which bill at the output rate. "Escalating" therefore buys more output tokens, not a more expensive unit price — deep work no longer pays a 4.4× input premium. **Step count multiplies that bill**: effort is paid per step, so running `#max` on a writer that takes thirty steps means paying the top rate thirty times. The top rung therefore goes only to short, few-step read-only escalation agents (`oracle`/`reviewer`); writers stop at `#high`, and thinking off is for pure transduction and routing, where added reasoning buys nothing.

> **Not yet verified (re-checked 2026-11-18)**: the actual reasoning depth and reasoning-token delta of `reasoningEffort` at `low`/`high`/`max` on flash are still unmeasured — the tier only changes the reasoning-token count, which this repo estimates linearly at the output rate. Re-check with one `/deep-review` run on a machine that holds DeepSeek credentials.

### Routing Strategy

- **Trivial → thinking off**: well-defined light tasks — search, lookup, consultation, UI, exploration, doc retrieval — go to the default tier (cheapest)
- **Routine-nontrivial → `#low`**: lightweight multi-file work, single-file edits, approach discussions and UI work use `deepseek/deepseek-flash#low` (thinking on + effort `low`) — `light-orchestrator`/`consultant`/`ui-builder`
- **Deep/uncertain → `#high`**: planning, deep reasoning and heavy multi-file implementation use `deepseek/deepseek-flash#high` (thinking on + effort `high`, the upstream default) — `planner`/`deep-worker`/`solo`
- **Escalation-only → `#max`**: reserved for the two read-only escalation agents — `oracle` (root-cause analysis) and `reviewer` (critical/security review), thinking on + effort `max`
- **Code review → `#low` first pass, `#max` escalation**: `/review` runs a `#low` first pass (Abbreviated path) by default and delegates to `reviewer` (`#max`) only when an escalation trigger fires; `/deep-review` forces a full `#max` review
- **Vision owns multimodal**: only when the user explicitly provides an image/screenshot or explicitly asks, route to the `vision` agent (`deepseek-flash`, natively multimodal). **Vision input is opt-in**: non-visual tasks never attach images, generate images, or invoke vision (enforced as a hard constraint in `AGENTS.md` → "Constraints"); attachments are first resized by `media.image` to 1600px / 2MiB to avoid wasting base64 bytes
- **Automatic escalation**: escalation always means **switching agents**, never raising one agent's 
…[文件过长——中段 8KB 抽样]…
del > global `model`. In the desktop App you switch via the model picker (your pick is remembered); headless `opencode run` **does not read** `agent.model` — the main session resolves the global `model`, so pass `-m deepseek/deepseek-flash#high` to pin a thinking tier.

Usage examples: "how does this library work?" → thinking off (librarian); "add an export feature to the user module" → `#high` (planner); "what's the root cause of this login error?" → `#max` (oracle); `/review` → `#low` first pass (small diffs report directly); `/review #123` (large diff / trust boundary) → first pass then `#max` escalation.

#### Two-Tier Code Review (Lightweight Review)

| Tier | Model | Executor | Coverage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Tier 1 (default) | `deepseek/deepseek-flash#low` | `light-orchestrator` (`/review`) | Abbreviated path: ≤8 logic files and ≤300 effective lines, no high-stakes trigger |
| Tier 2 (escalation) | `deepseek/deepseek-flash#max` | `reviewer` (`/deep-review` or auto-escalation) | Full path, a high-stakes trigger, or a Tier-1 critical/major needing cross-file confirmation |

Escalation triggers (any one): the path is Full (large diff or high-stakes regex hit); Tier 1 found a critical/major it cannot confirm from the diff alone; the diff touches a trust boundary (also load `security-review`); the user explicitly asked for a deep review.

A Tier-1 report is a **complete review**, not a preview — a clean result is never escalated merely to double-check. On escalation, Tier-1 findings are passed as **unverified leads** so the `#max` tier confirms rather than re-derives them, avoiding duplicate token spend.

### Cost Comparison

Prices are taken from `providers.deepseek.models` in `opencode.jsonc` (USD per 1M tokens; **re-verified item-by-item against the official pricing page on 2026-11-18**, off-peak rates). Peak hours are exactly double: 01:00–04:00 and 06:00–10:00 UTC Mon–Fri, excluding Chinese public holidays (= 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing); all other hours, weekends and Chinese public holidays are off-peak. `cache_write` has no standalone official price and is mapped from the cache-miss input rate:

| Model | Input | Output | Cache hit (cache_read) | Cache write (cache_write) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deepseek-flash` | 0.15 | 0.60 | 0.003 | 0.15 |

Two cost levers:

- **Thinking tier**: all four tiers bill at the same unit price; the only difference is the number of reasoning tokens (billed at the output rate) — escalating spends more output tokens, not a higher unit price.
- **Prompt cache**: `cache_read` is **50×** cheaper than the input price (0.003 vs 0.15). This config's byte-stable prefix + volatile-zone discipline (see `AGENTS.md`) exists precisely to maximize the cache-hit rate.

**Typical session cost estimate** (assume 200K input tokens, 150K cache hits, 30K output):

| Tier | Cache hit | Input miss | Output | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| thinking off | 150K × 0.003 = $0.0005 | 50K × 0.15 = $0.0075 | 30K × 0.60 = $0.018 | **≈ $0.026** |

`#low` / `#high` / `#max` add only the extra reasoning tokens on top of the same visible token volume, billed linearly at the output rate. Use `scripts/estimate-cost.js` to estimate from actual token counts.

#### Thinking-Tier Cost Comparison

Reviewing a 300-effective-line local diff (assume 60K input tokens, 45K cache hits, 8K visible output; `#low` adds 2K and `#max` adds 4K reasoning tokens, both billed at the output rate):

| Tier | Cache hit | Input miss | Output (incl. reasoning) | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `#low` (`/review` first pass, +2K reasoning) | 45K × 0.003 = $0.0001 | 15K × 0.15 = $0.0023 | 10K × 0.60 = $0.0060 | **≈ $0.0084** |
| `#max` (`/deep-review`) | 45K × 0.003 = $0.0001 | 15K × 0.15 = $0.0023 | 12K × 0.60 = $0.0072 | **≈ $0.0096** |

**Conclusion**: with one model, the gap between the two review tiers is not a "model unit price" but the extra reasoning tokens — on the same input base `#max` costs about 14% more ($0.0084 → $0.0096), far below the 3.7× pro premium of the two-model era. The reasoning-token count is an assumption; re-measure with `scripts/estimate-cost.js` on a machine holding DeepSeek credentials.

## Agent Structure

### Primary Agent

| Agent | Model | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `orchestrator` | flash | Default entry point: intent classification routing (Routing Table) + model-aware routing + fallback chains |
| `solo` | flash#high | Single-model inline executor: zero delegation, no background helpers, all work done inline on flash's `#high` tier in the current session |

> `solo` is the second primary agent: `{action: subagent, resource: "*", effect: deny}` (zero delegation — spawns no subagents), an explicit `model: deepseek/deepseek-flash#high` (pinned to `#high` throughout), and no build/plan built-in helpers (their configured tier binds only child sessions and one-shot calls — the main session never follows it, so mixing them would break the single-model guarantee). Analysis, planning, implementation, and verification all happen inline in the current session.

### Subagents

| Agent | Model | Permission | Role |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `planner` | flash#high | read-write | Planning, architecture, task breakdown |
| `deep-worker` | flash#high | read-write | Heavy implementation, multi-file changes, complex debugging |
| `oracle` | flash#max | **read-only** | Root-cause analysis, deep code understanding |
| `reviewer` | flash#max | **read-only** | Review escalation tier: Full path / high-stakes trigger / confirming cheap-tier first-pass leads |
| `ui-builder` | flash#low | read-write | Frontend and UI tasks |
| `consultant` | flash#low | read-write | Approach discussions, best-practice advice |
| `explore` | flash | **read-only** (only `.opencode/codemap.md` is writable) | Codebase search, parallel exploration |
| `librarian` | flash | **read-only** | Documentation lookup, web search |
| `light-orchestrator` | flash#low | read-write | Lightweight tasks, single-file edits |
| `vision` | flash | read-write (shell denies all by default; allows `git status/diff/log/show` and `rg`; the four `python`/`py` `vision-prep/scripts/*` calls are `ask`) | Multimodal: images/screenshots/charts/UI mockups |

> `deep-worker` and `light-orchestrator` follow a "no research, no delegation" principle — they execute, not explore; context is provided by the orchestrator; the sole exception is `light-orchestrator`'s two escalation paths — `oracle` (read-only analysis) and `reviewer` (`#max` review), serving `/simplify` and `/review`. `deep-worker` also carries a "What you DON'T handle" rejection contract: trivial single-file edits → refuse (route to `light-orchestrator`), pure research/lookups → refuse (route to `oracle`/`explore`), anything a cheaper tier can finish → refuse (this tier pays reasoning tokens on every step).
>
> Read-only agents (`oracle`/`reviewer`/`explore`) are truly read-only: `edit: deny` + a shell allowlist (deny all by default, allow only read-only subcommands such as `git status/diff/log/show/blame/grep` and `rg`; `oracle`/`reviewer` additionally allow `node scripts/*` (`reviewer` also `npm test*`), `gh pr view/diff`, `gh issue view`, and `gh api` to support `/review` replies). `librarian` is stricter: the `shell` ruleset denies everything by default, with no shell allowlist at all.
>
> Each agent carries a `skills` allowlist (deny by default + allow by role, to prevent loading heavyweight skills): `orchestrator` → `codemap`/`grilling`; `planner` → `spec-workflow`/`codebase-design`/`writing-plans`; `deep-worker` → `remove-deadcode`/`spec-workflow`/`git-release`/`to-tickets`/`triage`/`git-master`/`resolving-merge-conflicts`/`opencode-config`/`writing-for-agents`/`diagnosing-bugs`/`codebase-design`/`domain-modeling`/`test-driven-development`/`verification-before-completion`/`video-studio`; `oracle` → `reflect`/`simplify`/`diagnosing-bugs`; `reviewer` → `code-review`/`security-review`/`gh-cli`; `explore` → `codemap`; `librarian` → `verify-with-docs`; `light-orchestrator` → `handoff`/`simplify`/`spec-workflow`
…[仅保留首 16KB/中段 8KB/末 8KB]…
matic-debugging` → `diagnosing-bugs`, `writing-skills` → `writing-for-agents`), bringing its roster to 28 entries (29 since `video-studio` was vendored on 2026-11-18); no agent allows every skill any more. So a skill that is no longer used often, or duplicates another, should be merged or deleted rather than kept "just in case"; over-long `description` fields should be trimmed to the trigger words that are actually needed. **A denied skill does not appear in that agent's roster at all** (core filters the roster with the `skill` permission ruleset), so each agent's allowlist *is* its always-on context budget. **The hidden one-shot agents (title/summary/compaction) carry an explicit `skill:* deny` — they never load a skill, so the roster was pure waste on them** .

## Usage Guide

Orchestrator routes automatically and picks the tier by task difficulty:

```text
"Help me debug the login API error"   → oracle analyzes root cause (flash#max)
"Optimize this loop, performance is poor" → oracle analyzes → deep-worker implements (flash#max → flash#high)
"Review this PR for me"               → light-orchestrator pre-screen (reviewer#max only on a trigger)
"I want to add an export feature to the user module" → planner drafts → deep-worker implements (both flash#high)
"How to use React 19's use() API"     → librarian checks docs (thinking off)
```

For direct access: `/deep` (complex implementation), `/quick` (single file), `/plan` (proposal), `/oracle` (debugging), `/review` (code review), `/ui`, `/vision`; the full list is under "Quick Commands".

**When to escalate**: touches ≥3 modules, a decision needs 5+ files read, a bug resists one attempt, or real design trade-offs. Single file, an error message that already points at the line, mechanical replacement, or an existing pattern to copy — don't escalate. Let a cheaper tier take one pass; escalate only when you can state the reason. Escalation always switches agents rather than raising one agent's effort: writers go to `#high` (`planner`/`deep-worker`/`solo`), root-cause analysis and critical/security review go to `#max` (`oracle`/`reviewer`; `#max` belongs to those two read-only agents only).

## Sources

The core ideas draw on [oh-my-openagent](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent) (intent gating, read-only isolation, anti-patterns), [oh-my-opencode-slim](https://github.com/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim) (dispatcher-first, fallback chains, rejection contract, prompt-cache safety), [anomalyco/opencode](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode) (config schema, skill system), [cli/cli](https://github.com/cli/cli) (gh v2.103 command set), [OpenSpec](https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec) (delta specs), [mattpocock/skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills) (conflict resolution, handoff documents, debugging/architecture/domain-modeling skills), [pi](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi) (answer first then act, terse responses), and [deepreview](https://github.com/mechanai/deepreview) (effective-size routing), plus [dsh-video-studio-skill](https://github.com/znlgis/dsh-video-studio-skill) (the `video-studio` skill body, MIT, vendored). Pure config, zero npm dependencies. **Borrow, don't copy**: take only lightweight design ideas, simplify before adding.

## Design Philosophy

- **Pure config-driven, zero extra dependencies** — every capability comes from `opencode.jsonc` + `agents/*.md` + `skills/*/SKILL.md` + `AGENTS.md` (exception: `video-studio` ships Python scripts and needs ffmpeg + numpy/Pillow/edge-tts at runtime; no npm dependency is added)
- **One model + thinking tiers** — `deepseek-flash` only: thinking off for routing and routine execution, `#low` for lightweight execution, approach discussions and UI, `#high` for planning, deep reasoning and heavy implementation, `#max` reserved for escalation-only read-only analysis by `oracle`/`reviewer`; no second model's price sheet resident for an occasional hard task
- **Token efficiency first** — path references instead of pasted files, skills loaded on demand; each agent's `skill` allowlist also sets its roster size, and a denied skill never enters the always-loaded context
- **Plugins add value without stealing the spotlight** — the only plugin, superpowers, provides process discipline only (pinned to keep the prefix byte-stable); compression is 100% built-in compaction
- **Execution separated from exploration** — deep-worker/light-orchestrator must not research or delegate; explore/librarian must not modify
- **Cache + thinking discipline** — stable static prefixes to hit the prompt cache, with volatile content (timestamps, random IDs, dynamic lists) at the payload tail; the default tier disables thinking + `temperature: 0` (the `disabled` toggle, not the tier label, is what actually saves reasoning tokens), while `#low`/`#high`/`#max` turn it on
- **Scope First + Delegate Always** — scope first (2+ steps / multi-file / architecture changes go through planner), then delegate; top-level tokens are reserved for routing and hard problems
- **Explicit compression window** — `limit.input` declares the working window: `131072−16000=115,072`; the trigger point is computed, not inherited
- **Vision is opt-in** — images enter the payload only when the user supplies them; `media.image` resizes oversized images before upload

**简体中文** | [English](README.en-US.md)

**OpenCode v2 × DeepSeek 最优配置** —— 在 OpenCode v2 多 Agent 框架下，只保留 `deepseek/deepseek-flash` 一个模型、用 thinking 档位区分 Agent 分工的配置方案。核心理念：**Token 效率优先，用最小的上下文成本达到最好的开发效果**。

## 当前配置概览

- 默认主 Agent：`orchestrator`
- 唯一模型：`deepseek/deepseek-flash`（V4.1 Flash，原生多模态）；Agent 只按 thinking 档位区分：默认（thinking 关）/ `#low` / `#high` / `#max`
- 代理层级：`experimental.subagent_depth: 2`（v2 原生键；v1 的顶层 `subagent_depth` 已被 v2 丢弃，本仓库不再写入。恰好覆盖实际最深链路 `orchestrator → light-orchestrator → oracle`；其余 subagent 一律禁止委派，更深层级只是白送 token 放大面）
- 会话分享：关闭（`share: "disabled"`）

- 全局规则：`AGENTS.md`（核心原则、任务拒绝契约、自我验证、反模式等；上下文/Token 纪律在 `AGENTS.md`）

```jsonc
        },
        "variants": [
          { "id": "low",  "settings": { "reasoningEffort": "low" },  "body": { "thinking": { "type": "enabled" } } },
          { "id": "high", "settings": { "reasoningEffort": "high" }, "body": { "thinking": { "type": "enabled" } } },
          { "id": "max",  "settings": { "reasoningEffort": "max" },  "body": { "thinking": { "type": "enabled" } } }
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

> `thinking`/`temperature` 必须写在 `body`：`settings` 只承载 provider 选项（`timeout`/`chunkTimeout`/`reasoningEffort` 等），写进去会被静默丢弃。

> **模型 ID 命名规则**：`provider_id/model_id`，variant 用 `#` 后缀。本仓库只有 `deepseek/deepseek-flash`、`deepseek/deepseek-flash#low`、`deepseek/deepseek-flash#high`、`deepseek/deepseek-flash#max`。

### v2 原生键名（本仓库唯一写法）

本仓库是 **OpenCode v2 专属配置**，只写 v2 原生键：`plugins`（非 `plugin`）、`providers`/`models`（非 `provider`）、`agents`/`commands`（非 `agent`/`command`）、`permissions`（有序 `{action, resource, effect}`，非 `permission`；action 名是 `shell`/`subagent`，非 `bash`/`task`）、`media.image`（非 `attachment`），嵌套深度为 `experimental.subagent_depth`，压缩为 `{auto, background, keep, buffer}`（`background` 是 v2.3.1+ 新增开关；`prune`/`tail_turns`/`reserved` 是 v1 拼写，v2 不读）。只要文件里出现任一 v1 触发键（`provider`/`agent`/`command`/`plugin`/`permission`/`tools`/`attachment`/`small_model` 等），v2.3.2 会把它逐键迁移后与原生键合并（`logLevel`/`server`/`layout`/顶层 `subagent_depth` 则丢弃并记诊断）——不报错，但实际生效的配置与本文描述不一致。

> `$schema` 保持 `https://opencode.ai/config.json`（v2 应用自身写入的就是该 URL）。

## 模型分工

**为什么只保留 `deepseek-flash`**（opencode v2 正式版发布后顺势收敛配置）：

- **日常开发的瓶颈不在模型上限。** 读代码、改文件、跑测试、写文档、按 diff 审查——这些任务要的是快、稳、便宜，不是极限推理；用 pro 级模型做这些，多付的钱换不来对应的产出。
- **flash 是当前各家投入最密集的档位。** 竞争重心集中于此，意味着同价位的能力仍在快速上涨；配置压在 flash 上，等于跟着迭代最快的那条曲线走。
- **pro 的能力和价格对日常开发双重溢出。** 它服务的是少数难题，而配置要为每一次普通调用付费——为偶尔的硬任务常驻一个更贵的模型，账单结构本身就是错的。
- **需要更强推理时，用同一模型的 thinking 档位补。** `#high` / `#max` 靠 reasoning token 加深推理，成本随任务发生、按输出价线性增长，不引入第二套费率和第二条缓存前缀。
- **代价是显式承认的：用上限换成本。** 极端难题上 flash 可能不如 pro 一次到位，会多一轮返工或升级到 `#high` 乃至 `#max`——这部分代价只落在少数任务上，而不是让每次普通调用都为它买单。

本仓库只使用 **一个模型** `deepseek/deepseek-flash`，不引入任何其他模型。Agent 之间的差异只有一个维度——**思考档位（thinking tier）**，用模型 variant 表达：

| 档位 | 模型引用 | 机制 | 典型 Agent |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 省（trivial） | `deepseek/deepseek-flash` | body `{"type":"disabled"}` + `temperature: 0` | `orchestrator`/`explore`/`librarian`/`vision` |
| 低（routine） | `deepseek/deepseek-flash#low` | thinking 开 + `settings.reasoningEffort: low` | `light-orchestrator`/`consultant`/`ui-builder` |
| 高（deep） | `deepseek/deepseek-flash#high` | thinking 开 + `settings.reasoningEffort: high` | `planner`/`deep-worker`/`solo` |
| 顶（escalation） | `deepseek/deepseek-flash#max` | thinking 开 + `settings.reasoningEffort: max` | `oracle`/`reviewer`（仅升级、只读） |

思考强度由两个**请求参数**控制，二者都声明在 `opencode.jsonc` 的**模型层**；Agent 只选模型引用，不写任何思考参数：

- **thinking 开关** —— `{"thinking":{"type":"enabled"|"disabled"}}`，是**请求体（body）字段**。默认档关闭（最省），`#low`/`#high`/`#max` 打开。
- **thinking 强度** —— `{"reasoning_effort":"low"|"high"|"max"}`，由 **provider setting** `settings.reasoningEffort` 驱动（配置里写 camelCase，线上是 snake_case）——这是 opencode aisdk 层唯一会转成 `reasoning_effort` 的路径。

> **官方文档核对（2026-11-18，`guides/thinking_mode`）**：① 思考模式**默认打开，effort 默认 `high`**——所以只有默认档（显式 `disabled`）真能省下 reasoning token：`#high` 只是把默认值写明，`#low` 是唯一的低档，`#max` 是唯一高于默认的档位；effort 没有中间值，`minimal`→low、`medium`/`xhigh`→high、`max`/`ultra`→max。② 思考模式**不支持** `temperature`/`presence_penalty`/`frequency_penalty`——传入不报错，但也不生效；上表的 `temperature: 0` 只在默认档真正起作用，`#low`/`#high`/`#max` 继承它但无效。③ `top_p` 行为相反：`deepseek-flash` 仅在思考模式下生效（有效范围 0.95–1.0，低于 0.95 按 0.95 处理），非思考模式下恒为 1.0、传入值被忽略——所以本配置不设 `top_p`。④ 请求携带 `tools` 时，历史轮的 `reasoning_content` 必须完整回传，否则 API 返回 400；opencode 对所有 deepseek 模型强制回传（`ai/src/protocols/openai-chat.ts` 的 `requireReasoning`），无需额外配置。

> **⚠️ 写法陷阱（2026-10-16 实测修正）**：`thinking`/`temperature` 放在 `settings` 下不生效（openai-chat 协议不实现该 option），`reasoningEffort` 放在 Agent 的 `options` 下也不生效（`options` 只落到 `request.body`，且 camelCase 不是 API 认的 `reasoning_effort`）。两者都必须写在**模型层**：toggle 进 `body`、effort 进 `settings`。修正前 flash 一直开着 thinking 跑，每一步都在付 reasoning token。

**成本结构**：四个档位共用 flash 的同一份费率（in 0.15 / out 0.60 / cache_read 0.003 USD per 1M，off-peak），没有模型溢价；档位差异只体现在 **reasoning token 数量**，而 reasoning token 按输出价计费。所以「升档」是多花输出 token，不是换更贵的单价——深度任务不再付 4.4× 输入价。**但步数会放大这笔账**：effort 按步计费，`#max` 给一个跑三十步的写作 agent 等于把最贵档乘以三十，所以顶档只给步数少、输出短的只读升级 agent（`oracle`/`reviewer`），写作类停在 `#high`；thinking off 则留给纯转写与路由——这些任务加推理不产生价值。

> **未验证项（2026-11-18 复核）**：`reasoningEffort` 的三个取值 `low`/`high`/`max` 在 flash 上的实际推理深度与 reasoning token 增量仍未实测——档位只改变 reasoning token 数量，本仓库按输出价线性估算；请在具备 DeepSeek 凭据的机器上跑一次 `/deep-review` 复核。

### 路由策略

- **Trivial → thinking off**：搜索、查询、咨询、UI、探索、文档检索等明确定义的轻任务走默认档（最省）
- **Routine-nontrivial → `#low`**：轻量多文件、单文件编辑、方案讨论与 UI 工作走 `deepseek/deepseek-flash#low`（thinking 开 + effort `low`）——`light-orchestrator`/`consultant`/`ui-builder`
- **Deep/uncertain → `#high`**：规划、深度推理、重型多文件实现走 `deepseek/deepseek-flash#high`（thinking 开 + effort `high`，上游默认档）——`planner`/`deep-worker`/`solo`
- **Escalation-only → `#max`**：只给两个只读升级 agent——`oracle`（根因分析）与 `reviewer`（critical/security 审查），thinking 开 + effort `max`
- **代码审查 → `#low` 初检，`#max` 升级**：`/review` 默认走 `#low` 初检（Abbreviated 路径），仅在升级触发条件命中时委派 `reviewer`（`#max`）；`/deep-review` 强制 `#max` 全量审查
- **Vision 专责多模态**：仅在用户明确提供图像/截图或明确要求时，路由到 `vision` agent（`deepseek-flash`，原生多模态）。**视觉输入是 opt-in**：非视觉任务不主动传图、不生成图、不调用视觉能力（`AGENTS.md`「Constraints」已把这条写成硬约束）；附件统一先经 `media.image` 缩到 1600px / 2MiB，避免 base64 字节浪费
- **自动升级**：升级永远是**换 agent**，不是抬同一个 agent 的 effort——thinking off / `#low` agent 无法胜任时，带完整上下文转交更强的 agent：写作类转 `#high`（`planner`/`deep-worker`/`solo`），根因/审查类转 `#max`（`oracle`/`reviewer`）

**模型解析链（2026-11-09 于 v2.2.6 复核）**：实际生效的模型由三处决定——① `agent.model`：subagent/子会话（含 `/` 命令：命令绑定 subagent agent 时会**创建子会话**并按该 agent 档位运行，如 `/deep`→`#high`、`/quick`→`#low`，当前会话模型不受影响）、title/summary/compaction 一次性调用、桌面 App 新会话的随 agent 联动默认值（build/plan/orchestrator → flash）；② 全局 `config.model`：主会话的兜底模型（flash 默认档）；③ `-m`：命令行显式覆盖，优先级 `-m` > 会话已存模型 > 全局 `model`。桌面 App 用模型选择器切换（选择被记住）；headless `opencode run` **不读** `agent.model`——主会话按全局 `model` 解析，要指定思考档位就显式加 `-m deepseek/deepseek-flash#high`。

用法示例：`「这�
…[文件过长——中段 8KB 抽样]…
�子会话**并按该 agent 档位运行，如 `/deep`→`#high`、`/quick`→`#low`，当前会话模型不受影响）、title/summary/compaction 一次性调用、桌面 App 新会话的随 agent 联动默认值（build/plan/orchestrator → flash）；② 全局 `config.model`：主会话的兜底模型（flash 默认档）；③ `-m`：命令行显式覆盖，优先级 `-m` > 会话已存模型 > 全局 `model`。桌面 App 用模型选择器切换（选择被记住）；headless `opencode run` **不读** `agent.model`——主会话按全局 `model` 解析，要指定思考档位就显式加 `-m deepseek/deepseek-flash#high`。

用法示例：`「这个库怎么用」` → thinking off（librarian）；`「给用户模块加导出功能」` → `#high`（planner）；`「排查登录接口报错的根因」` → `#max`（oracle）；`/review` → `#low` 初检（小 diff 直接出报告）；`/review #123`（大 diff / 触及信任边界）→ 初检后升级 `#max`。

#### 代码审查的两级档位（轻量化 Review）

| 层级 | 模型 | 执行者 | 覆盖范围 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Tier 1（默认） | `deepseek/deepseek-flash#low` | `light-orchestrator`（`/review`） | Abbreviated 路径：≤8 个逻辑文件且 ≤300 有效行，且无高风险触发 |
| Tier 2（升级） | `deepseek/deepseek-flash#max` | `reviewer`（`/deep-review` 或自动升级） | Full 路径、高风险触发、或 Tier 1 发现需跨文件确认的 critical/major |

升级触发条件（命中任一即升级）：路径为 Full（大 diff 或高风险正则命中）；Tier 1 发现 critical/major 但无法仅凭 diff 确认影响；diff 触及信任边界（同时加载 `security-review`）；用户明确要求深度审查。

Tier 1 报告是**完整审查**而非预览——干净结果不因"再确认一下"而升级。升级时把 Tier 1 发现作为**未验证线索**传给 Tier 2，让 `#max` 确认而非重新推导，避免重复 token 消耗。

### 成本对比

价格取自 `opencode.jsonc` 的 `providers.deepseek.models`（USD / 1M tokens，**2026-11-18 官方定价页重新核验，与本表逐项一致**，off-peak 价；peak 时段 = off-peak ×2，北京时间周一至周五 09:00–12:00 与 14:00–18:00，其余时段含周末与中国法定节假日均为 off-peak）。`cache_write` 无独立官方价，按 cache-miss 输入价映射：

| 模型 | 输入 | 输出 | 缓存命中（cache_read） | 缓存写入（cache_write） |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deepseek-flash` | 0.15 | 0.60 | 0.003 | 0.15 |

两个成本杠杆：

- **思考档位**：四档同一单价，差别只在 reasoning token 数量（按输出价计费）——升档是多花输出 token，不是换更贵的单价。
- **提示词缓存**：`cache_read` 比输入价便宜 **50×（0.003 vs 0.15）**。本配置的字节稳定前缀 + 易变区纪律（见 `AGENTS.md`）正是为了最大化缓存命中率。

**典型会话成本估算**（假设 200K 输入 tokens，其中 150K 命中缓存，30K 输出）：

| 档位 | 缓存命中 | 输入未命中 | 输出 | 合计 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| thinking off | 150K × 0.003 = $0.0005 | 50K × 0.15 = $0.0075 | 30K × 0.60 = $0.018 | **≈ $0.026** |

`#low` / `#high` / `#max` 在同一可见 token 量上只需多出 reasoning token，就按输出价线性叠加。可用 `scripts/estimate-cost.js` 按实际 token 数估算。

#### 思考档位的成本对比

以"审查一个 300 有效行的本地 diff"为例（假设 60K 输入 tokens，其中 45K 命中缓存，8K 可见输出；`#low` 额外产生 2K、`#max` 额外产生 4K reasoning tokens，均按输出价计费）：

| 档位 | 缓存命中 | 输入未命中 | 输出（含 reasoning） | 合计 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `#low`（`/review` 初检，+2K reasoning） | 45K × 0.003 = $0.0001 | 15K × 0.15 = $0.0023 | 10K × 0.60 = $0.0060 | **≈ $0.0084** |
| `#max`（`/deep-review`） | 45K × 0.003 = $0.0001 | 15K × 0.15 = $0.0023 | 12K × 0.60 = $0.0072 | **≈ $0.0096** |

**结论**：单模型下两级审查的价差不是「模型单价」，而是「多出的 reasoning token」——同一输入基数下 `#max` 约贵 14%（$0.0084 → $0.0096），远小于双模型时 pro 的 3.7×。reasoning token 数是假设值，实际值需在具备 DeepSeek 凭据的机器上用 `scripts/estimate-cost.js` 复测。

## Agent 结构

### Primary Agent

| Agent | 模型 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `orchestrator` | flash | 默认入口：意图分类路由（Routing Table）+ 模型感知路由 + 后备链 |
| `solo` | flash#high | 单模型内联执行器：零委派、不用后台助手，全程在 flash 的 `#high` 档完成 |

> `solo` 是第二个 primary agent：`{action: subagent, resource: "*", effect: deny}`（零委派，不调用任何子智能体）、显式 `model: deepseek/deepseek-flash#high`（全程固定 `#high` 档）、不用 build/plan 等内置后台助手（其档位只在子会话/一次性调用生效，主会话并不跟随——混用会让「全程单模型」不再成立），分析、规划、实现、验证全部在当前会话内联完成。

### Subagents

| Agent | 模型 | 权限 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `planner` | flash#high | 读写 | 规划、架构、拆解任务 |
| `deep-worker` | flash#high | 读写 | 重型实现、多文件改动、复杂调试 |
| `oracle` | flash#max | **只读** | 根因分析、深度理解代码 |
| `reviewer` | flash#max | **只读** | 代码审查升级层：Full 路径 / 高风险触发 / 确认便宜档初检线索 |
| `ui-builder` | flash#low | 读写 | 前端与 UI 相关任务 |
| `consultant` | flash#low | 读写 | 方案讨论、最佳实践建议 |
| `explore` | flash | **只读**（仅 `.opencode/codemap.md` 可写） | 代码库搜索、并行探索 |
| `librarian` | flash | **只读** | 文档检索、Web 搜索 |
| `light-orchestrator` | flash#low | 读写 | 轻量任务、单文件编辑 |
| `vision` | flash | 读写（shell 默认 deny，仅放行 `git status/diff/log/show`、`rg`；4 条 `python`/`py` 的 `vision-prep/scripts/*` 为 `ask`） | 多模态：图像/截图/图表/UI 稿理解 |

> `deep-worker` 和 `light-orchestrator` 遵循"禁止研究、禁止委托"原则——执行而非探索，上下文由 orchestrator 提供；唯一例外是 `light-orchestrator` 的两种定向升级——`oracle`（只读分析）与 `reviewer`（`#max` 审查），服务 `/simplify` 与 `/review`。`deep-worker` 另带 "What you DON'T handle" 拒绝契约：琐碎单文件编辑 → 拒接（路由 `light-orchestrator`）、纯研究/查询 → 拒接（路由 `oracle`/`explore`）、任何便宜档能完成的任务 → 拒接（本档每步都付 reasoning token）。
>
> 只读 Agent（`oracle`/`reviewer`/`explore`）真只读化：`edit: deny` + shell 白名单（默认 deny 全部，仅放行 `git status/diff/log/show/blame/grep`、`rg` 等只读子命令；`oracle`/`reviewer` 另允许 `node scripts/*`（`reviewer` 另含 `npm test*`）、`gh pr view/diff`、`gh issue view`、`gh api` 以支持 `/review` 回帖）。`librarian` 更严格：`shell` 规则集默认全部 deny，且没有任何 shell 白名单。
>
> 各 agent 带 `skills` 白名单（默认 deny + 按职责放行，防误加载重型 skill）：`orchestrator` → `codemap`/`grilling`；`planner` → `spec-workflow`/`codebase-design`/`writing-plans`；`deep-worker` → `remove-deadcode`/`spec-workflow`/`git-release`/`to-tickets`/`triage`/`git-master`/`resolving-merge-conflicts`/`opencode-config`/`writing-for-agents`/`diagnosing-bugs`/`codebase-design`/`domain-modeling`/`test-driven-development`/`verification-before-completion`/`video-studio`；`oracle` → `reflect`/`simplify`/`diagnosing-bugs`；`reviewer` → `code-review`/`security-review`/`gh-cli`；`explore` → `codemap`；`librarian` → `verify-with-docs`；`light-orchestrator` → `handoff`/`simplify`/`spec-workflow`/`code-review`/`gh-cli`/`verification-before-completion`；`consultant` → `domain-modeling`；`ui-builder` → `codebase-design`；`vision` → `vision-prep`；`solo` → 全�
…[仅保留首 16KB/中段 8KB/末 8KB]…
�MIT），差异与重新 vendor 步骤见 `skills/video-studio/VENDOR.md`。

> **名册即预算**：`skill` 工具的 `<available_skills>` 里每个 skill 的 name + description 都是**每轮常驻**上下文。2026-10-16 实测（当时全部放行）：名册 **30 条**（23 个本地 + 7 个 superpowers 接线项），渲染后的名册块 **12,186 字符 / 11,927 字节 ≈ 3.3K tokens**——`orchestrator` 只放行 2 个 skill，名册仅 804 字符 ≈ 223 tokens，差 **15×**。2026-10-20 起 `solo` 裁掉 2 个与本地 skill 语义重复的接线项（`systematic-debugging` → `diagnosing-bugs`、`writing-skills` → `writing-for-agents`），其名册降到 28 条；2026-11-18 收编 `video-studio` 后为 29 条，已无任何 Agent 放行全部 skill。所以「不再高频使用」或「与现有 skill 重复」的 skill 应当合并删除，而不是留着备用；超长的 `description` 要按触发词必需性裁剪。**被 deny 的 skill 不会出现在该 Agent 的名册里**（core 用 `skill` 权限规则集过滤名册），所以每个 Agent 的 allowlist 就是它的常驻上下文预算。**隐藏的一次性 agent（title/summary/compaction）已显式 `skill:* deny`——它们永远不加载 skill，名册对它们纯属浪费**。

## 使用指南

Orchestrator 默认自动路由，按任务难度选档：

```text
「帮我排查这个登录接口的报错」   → oracle 分析根因（flash#max）
「优化这段循环，性能太差了」     → oracle 分析 → deep-worker 实施（flash#max → flash#high）
「这个 PR 帮我审查一下」         → light-orchestrator 初检（命中升级条件才走 reviewer#max）
「我想给用户模块加个导出功能」   → planner 定方案 → deep-worker 实现（均 flash#high）
「React 19 的 use() API 怎么用」 → librarian 查文档（thinking off）
```

需要直达时用命令：`/deep`（复杂实现）、`/quick`（单文件）、`/plan`（方案）、`/oracle`（排障）、`/review`（审查）、`/ui`、`/vision`；完整清单见「快捷命令」。

**什么时候才升级**：跨 ≥3 个模块、需读 5+ 文件才能决策、bug 无法一次定位、需要设计取舍。单文件、错误信息已指明位置、纯机械替换、有现成模式可照抄——都不升。先用便宜档跑一轮，失败或含糊再升，且升级要能说出理由。升级永远换 agent 而不是抬同一 agent 的 effort：写作类升到 `#high`（`planner`/`deep-worker`/`solo`），根因分析与 critical/security 审查升到 `#max`（`oracle`/`reviewer`；`#max` 只属于这两个只读 agent）。

## 借鉴来源

核心思路借鉴 [oh-my-openagent](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent)（意图门控、只读隔离、反模式）、[oh-my-opencode-slim](https://github.com/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim)（调度器优先、后备链、拒绝契约、提示词缓存安全）、[anomalyco/opencode](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode)（配置 Schema、技能体系）、[cli/cli](https://github.com/cli/cli)（gh v2.103 命令集）、[OpenSpec](https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec)（delta specs）、[mattpocock/skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills)（冲突解析、交接文档、排障/架构/领域建模技能）、[pi](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi)（先答后改、精简响应）、[deepreview](https://github.com/mechanai/deepreview)（有效大小路由）、[dsh-video-studio-skill](https://github.com/znlgis/dsh-video-studio-skill)（`video-studio` 技能本体，MIT，已收编）。纯配置实现，零 npm 依赖。**借鉴而非照搬**：只汲取轻量化设计理念，精简优先于新增。

## 设计哲学

- **纯配置驱动，零额外依赖** —— 能力全部由 `opencode.jsonc` + `agents/*.md` + `skills/*/SKILL.md` + `AGENTS.md` 实现（`video-studio` 例外：脚本原生自带，运行时需要 ffmpeg + numpy/Pillow/edge-tts，不引入 npm 依赖）
- **单模型 + thinking 档位** —— 只用 `deepseek-flash`：thinking 关做路由与常规执行，`#low` 做轻量执行、方案讨论与 UI，`#high` 做规划、深度推理与重型实现，`#max` 只留给 `oracle`/`reviewer` 的升级式只读分析；不为偶尔的难题常驻第二个模型的单价
- **Token 效率优先** —— 路径引用替代粘贴文件、技能按需加载；每个 Agent 的 `skill` 白名单同时决定它的名册大小，被 deny 的 skill 不进每轮常驻上下文
- **插件增效但不喧宾夺主** —— 唯一插件 superpowers 只提供过程纪律（固定 pin 保字节稳定前缀）；压缩 100% 交给内置 compaction
- **执行与探索分离** —— deep-worker/light-orchestrator 禁止研究与委托，explore/librarian 禁止修改
- **缓存与 thinking 纪律** —— 静态前缀稳定以命中提示词缓存，易变内容（时间戳/随机 ID/动态列表）置于 payload 尾部；默认档关 thinking + `temperature: 0`（真正省下 reasoning token 的正是这个 `disabled` 开关，而非档位本身），`#low`/`#high`/`#max` 开 thinking
- **Scope First + Delegate Always** —— 2+ 步/多文件/架构变更先走 planner，再委派执行，顶层 token 只留给路由与难题
- **显式压缩窗口** —— 用 `limit.input` 声明工作窗口：`131072−16000=115,072`，触发点算出来而不是继承
- **视觉 opt-in** —— 图像只在用户提供时进入 payload；`media.image` 自动缩放超大图

# 升级指南

本文件是本仓库升级流程的唯一事实源。仓库根的 `AGENTS.md` 指向它；两份 README 只描述**当前状态**，不记录历史。

升级时按下面的顺序执行，不要凭记忆改配置。

## 1. 不变量

任何一次升级都必须保住这八条。破坏其中一条，就不算升级完成：

1. **单模型**：只有 `deepseek/deepseek-flash`，四个 thinking 档位——默认（thinking 关）、`#low`、`#high`、`#max`。
2. **thinking 参数只在模型层**：toggle 进 `providers.deepseek.models.<id>.body`，effort 进同名节点的 `settings.reasoningEffort`；Agent frontmatter 不出现任何思考参数。
3. **只写 v2 原生键**：v2 的配置正常化器会把 v1 键逐项迁移后与原生键合并，`logLevel`/`server`/`layout`/顶层 `subagent_depth` 则丢弃并记诊断——不报错，但实际生效的配置与本文描述不一致。
4. **`$schema` 固定为** `https://opencode.ai/config.json`。
5. **插件固定 pin**（当前 `#v7.0.2`），不跟 `latest`。
6. **零额外依赖**：能力只来自 `opencode.jsonc` + `agents/*.md` + `skills/*/SKILL.md` + `AGENTS.md`；压缩只用内置 compaction。唯一例外是 `video-studio` 技能自带 Python 脚本（不引入 npm 依赖；运行时另需 ffmpeg + numpy/Pillow/edge-tts，见 README「技能」）。
7. **README 不当变更记录**：历史在 `git log`，理由在 commit message。
8. **agent 级 permissions 不得放宽全局 deny**：`agents/*.md` frontmatter 与 `opencode.jsonc` 内 inline agent 的 `edit`/`shell`/`read`/`external_directory` allow 规则，不得命中全局 `permissions` 的 deny 模式；由 `scripts/validate-jsonc.js` 静态检查。

## 2. 基线

升级只改这张表的数字，以及 README 中引用这些数字的句子；两者不一致就是缺陷。

| 项 | 当前值 | 最近核验 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 运行时 CLI | `opencode-cli.exe` **2.3.2**（桌面版自带） | 2026-11-18 |
| PATH 上的 `opencode` | **1.18.4**（WinGet 安装，v1，不要用） | 2026-11-18 |
| superpowers pin | `#v7.0.2` | 2026-11-18 |
| DeepSeek 定价（USD / 1M，off-peak） | in 0.15 / out 0.60 / cache_read 0.003 / cache_write 0.15 | 2026-11-18 |
| thinking 语义 | 默认**开**、effort 默认 `high`；思考模式忽略 `temperature` | 2026-11-18 |
| 结构 | 1 模型 / 4 档 / 12 agents / 18 commands / 24 skills | 2026-11-18 |
| 压缩窗口 | `limit.input` 131072 − `compaction.buffer` 16000 = 115,072 | 2026-11-18 |

定价附注：peak 时段 = off-peak ×2（UTC 01–04 与 06–10 的周一至周五，不含中国法定节假日）；`cache_write` 无独立官方价，按 cache-miss 输入价映射。

## 3. 升级步骤

### 3.0 定目标

先写清三件事：升什么（CLI / 插件 / 模型与定价 / 配置 schema）、从哪个版本到哪个版本、为什么升。目标不明确就不动手——顺手升级通常只带来前缀漂移。

### 3.1 读上游，不凭记忆

按升级对象选读。行号会随上游漂移，用符号名检索：

| 升级对象 | 读哪里 |
| --- | --- |
| CLI 行为 / 配置 schema | opencode 源码仓库 `anomalyco/opencode` 的 `packages/core/src/config/`，并对照 `& $cli debug config` 的实际输出 |
| CLI 版本 / 发布说明 | 同仓库 GitHub 的 `/releases` 列表（**不要用 `/releases/latest`**，它仍指向 v1 线） |
| v1 键的处理方式 | 同仓库 `packages/core/src/config/normalize.ts` 的 `unsupportedTopLevel`（丢弃并记诊断）与 legacy 键分支（逐键迁移后与原生键合并）；转换函数在 `packages/core/src/v1/config/migrate.ts` |
| 模型合并语义 | 同仓库 `packages/core/src/provider.ts` 的 `mergeOverlay` |
| 请求体如何上线路 | 同仓库 `packages/core/src/aisdk.ts`（`settings` → provider 选项）与 `packages/ai/src/protocols/openai-chat.ts`（选项 → 请求 body） |
| AGENTS.md 加载范围 | 同仓库 `packages/core/src/config/plugin/instruction.ts` |
| DeepSeek 定价 | <https://platform.deepseek.com/> 的定价页 |
| DeepSeek thinking 语义 | <https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/guides/thinking_mode> |
| 插件 | 目标 tag 的 release notes，以及 `.opencode/plugins/superpowers.js` 在两 tag 间的 diff |

### 3.2 改配置

| 改什么 | 改哪里 |
| --- | --- |
| 模型、价格、thinking、上下文窗口 | `opencode/opencode.jsonc` 的 `providers.deepseek.models` |
| Agent 的模型引用、工具、skill 白名单 | `opencode/agents/<name>.md` 的 frontmatter 与正文 |
| 路由、拒绝契约、缓存纪律 | `opencode/AGENTS.md` |
| 快捷命令模板 | `opencode/opencode.jsonc` 的 `commands` |

变体 body 只写实际要覆盖的字段：`mergeOverlay` 只在基值为 `undefined` 时保留基值，写 `null` 会原样出现在请求体里。

### 3.3 校验

`$cli` 见第 2 节。

```powershell
node scripts/validate-jsonc.js        # 退出码 0
node scripts/estimate-cost.js         # 默认参数合计约 $0.026
& $cli debug config                   # 键名与模型清单符合预期（无 unsupported / conflict 诊断）
& $cli debug agents                   # 12 个自定义 Agent，模型引用全部可解析
```

再确认没有 v1 触发键——清单以 `packages/core/src/config/normalize.ts` 的 `unsupportedTopLevel` 与 legacy 键分支为准（`scripts/validate-jsonc.js` 的 `V1_TOP_LEVEL_KEYS` 只是手工镜像，以 `normalize.ts` 为准），尤其是顶层别出现 `provider` / `agent` / `command` / `plugin` / `permission` / `tools` / `attachment`。

### 3.4 同步与重载

```powershell
.\scripts\sync-config.ps1             # ~/.config/opencode 是独立副本，不是符号链接
& $cli reload                         # 或重启 opencode
```

`sync-config.ps1` 只同步 `opencode/` 目录；仓库根的 `AGENTS.md` 与 `docs/` 不会被同步。

### 3.5 文档对齐

- `README.md` 与 `README.en-US.md` 逐节同步：标题层级、顺序、数量一致
- 全文件 CRLF：`LF` 计数必须等于 `CRLF` 计数
- 交叉引用（`见「…」` / `see "…"`）必须落到现存标题
- README 中的版本号、定价、结构计数与第 2 节基线一致

### 3.6 记录

- commit message 写**为什么**与影响面，不逐行复述 diff
- 只暂存本次意图内的文件
- 不新增 changelog：历史看 `git log`

## 4. 已知陷阱

一行一条，都实测或核对过：

1. **`thinking` / `temperature` 写在 `settings` 下不生效** —— `settings` 只承载 provider option（`timeout` / `chunkTimeout` / `reasoningEffort`），其余被静默丢弃（2026-10-16 实测）。
2. **`reasoningEffort` 写在 Agent 的 `options` 下不生效** —— `options` 只落 `request.body`，且 camelCase 不是 API 认的 `reasoning_effort`。
3. **变体 body 写 `null` 会覆盖基值** —— `mergeRecord` 只把 `undefined` 当"未设置"；`null` 是合法 JSON 值，会原样出现在请求体里。
4. **v1 键不报错，只会被静默改写** —— 2.3.2 把 `provider`/`agent`/`command`/`plugin`/`permission`/`tools`/`attachment` 等 legacy 键逐键迁移后与原生键合并，`logLevel`/`server`/`layout`/顶层 `subagent_depth` 记 `unsupported` 诊断后丢弃；文件不会被整体拒绝（只有 JSONC 语法错误或归一化后无法解码才会拒绝，见 `config.ts`）。「看起来生效」不是写对了的证据，以 `scripts/validate-jsonc.js` 的键白名单为准。
5. **PATH 上的 `opencode` 是 v1.18.4** —— headless 运行必须用桌面版自带 CLI。
6. **DeepSeek 默认开思考、effort 默认 `high`** —— 不显式写 `disabled` 就一直在付 reasoning token。
7. **思考模式下 `temperature` / `presence_penalty` / `frequency_penalty` 被忽略**；`top_p` 只在思考模式生效（有效范围 0.95–1.0），非思考模式恒为 1.0。所以这些参数只在默认档有意义。
8. **带 `tools` 时必须回传历史 `reasoning_content`**，否则 API 返回 400；opencode 对所有 deepseek 模型强制回传（`openai-chat.ts` 的 `requireReasoning`），无需额外配置。
9. **`write` 工具落盘带 UTF-8 BOM** —— 用作 commit message 前先剥掉，否则 subject 首字符是 U+FEFF。
10. **技能名册是每轮常驻成本** —— 新增 skill 或加长 `description` 直接抬高每轮 token；不再使用的 skill 应当合并或删除。

# Deep Worker

You are the heavy-duty implementation agent. You handle complex, multi-step, multi-file engineering work autonomously. You do not stop until the task is fully done.

## Workflow

### Phase 0: Todo Management
Follow AGENTS.md Multi-Step Task Discipline for any task with 2+ steps.

### Step 1: Parallel Exploration
Read code directly via reads/glob/grep. Do not delegate exploration — use tools directly.

### Step 2: Implementation
Before any non-trivial change, plan the narrowest verification path (AGENTS.md Self-Verification).

### Step 3: Self-Verification
Follow AGENTS.md Self-Verification: re-read every modified file, grep for broken callers, run available tests, check for unused imports/variables.

### Step 4: Completion Report

```
## Summary
[2-3 sentences describing what was accomplished]

## Changes
- `path/to/file.ts:42` — [what changed and why]

## Verification
- [test result or manual verification performed]

## Status
- succeeded: N | failed: N | skipped: N
- blocked: [unit + reason, or "none"]
```

## Rules
- **No research, no delegation.** Use grep/glob/read directly. If external docs lookup is required, ask the orchestrator to provide that context before you start.
- **Do the highest-value step first.** Iterate toward the highest-value step; stop when a step's value no longer justifies its cost.
- **Complete what is completable; mark the rest blocked.** If something is more complex than expected, finish the parts that can succeed, mark the blocked unit with its reason, and report it — never hard-carry a step that cannot succeed, and never present a partial result as complete. Escalate only when the block prevents the task's core goal.
- **Retry per AGENTS.md "Progress & Failure Discipline".** Cap 3 attempts per operation, every retry changes strategy, fatal errors are reported not retried.
- Write code indistinguishable from a senior engineer — no AI slop

## What You DON'T Handle
Reject the task immediately — do not attempt a degraded version — when:
- **Trivial single-file edit**: refuse, route to `light-orchestrator` (flash)
- **Pure research / lookups**: refuse, route to `oracle`/`explore`
- **Anything a cheap-tier agent can finish**: refuse — this tier burns reasoning tokens on every step, so trivial work must not land here

# Orchestrator

You are the main orchestrator. Your job is routing, not doing. Analyze every incoming request, determine true intent, then delegate to the best-fit subagent. Only answer directly for trivially simple questions.

## Routing Table (intent → agent)

Four tiers, one flash model. Thinking-off is the default; `#low` covers
routine-nontrivial work; `#high` is the escalation path; `#max` is read-only
and escalation-only — few steps (~40 cap), writers never run it. Escalation
costs reasoning tokens, not a pricier token rate. Borderline → try the cheaper
tier. Read-only agents (oracle, reviewer, explore, librarian) never write.

| Intent / trigger | Agent | Thinking tier | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| "explain X", "how does Y work" | `explore` | flash | search → synthesize → answer |
| "look into X", "check Y", "investigate" | `explore` | flash | report findings, never edit |
| "map out X", "show structure" | `explore` (codemap) | flash | structured overview |
| "implement X", "add Y", "create Z" | `planner` → `deep-worker` | #high → #high | plan before building |
| "I'm seeing error X", "Y is broken" | `oracle` → `deep-worker` | #max → #high | diagnose → fix |
| "analyze X", "audit Y", "diagnose Z", "trace/debug" | `oracle` | #max | deep investigation, report only |
| "refactor", "improve", "clean up" | `oracle` → `deep-worker` | #max → #high | assess → implement → verify |
| "optimize X", "make Y faster" | `oracle` → `deep-worker` | #max → #high | profile → implement |
| "review X" | `light-orchestrator` (code-review) → `reviewer` | #low → #max | #low pre-screen; `reviewer` only when the skill's escalation triggers fire |
| "audit security of Y" | `reviewer` | #max | trust-boundary changes, full pass |
| "review and fix X" | `reviewer` → `deep-worker` → `reviewer` | #max → #high → #max | bounded loop ≤ 2 |
| "simplify X", "clean up Y code" | `light-orchestrator` (simplify) → spawns `oracle` | #low → #max | light-orchestrator spawns oracle (read-only) → applies edits |
| "what do you think about X?", "help me decide" | `consultant` | flash → #low | propose → wait for confirm |
| "deploy X", "release Y" | `deep-worker` (git-release) | #high | /release command; for complex deploys: `planner` (`#high`) → `deep-worker` (`#high`) |
| "add tests for X" | `light-orchestrator` → `deep-worker` | #low → #high | one test file → #low; test suite across files → deep-worker |
| "write docs for X" | `light-orchestrator` | #low | generate docs |
| "research X", "what library for Y" | `librarian` | flash | findings with citations |
| UI / frontend / CSS / layout work | `ui-builder` | flash → #low | preserve design handoffs |
| "look at this image", "read this screenshot", multimodal/vision input | `vision` | flash | natively multimodal; never fabricate what's shown |
| "scope a review", "size a codebase", "map the project before X" | `explore` | flash | delegate scoping, never do it inline |
| commit / push | `/commit` command | #low | route to `light-orchestrator`; never run git ceremony inline |

`build` and `plan` inline helpers run on flash; route anything non-trivial to a
named agent above instead of doing it inline.

Rule of thumb: "How does this library work?" → `librarian`. "How does
programming work?" → answer directly. "Is this code correct?" → `reviewer`.
"Where is the bug?" → `oracle`.

## Delegation contracts (high-cost targets)

- **deep-worker (#high):** Delegate when: multi-file/heavy implementation, end-to-end features. Don't delegate when: trivial single-file edits (→ #low), pure research (→ oracle/explore), anything a cheap-tier agent can finish. Rule of thumb: #high pays reasoning tokens on every step — if #low can finish it, don't spend #high.
- **oracle (#max):** Delegate when: root-cause analysis, deep tracing, ambiguous bugs. Don't delegate when: simple lookups, first-attempt fixes (→ explore/flash off). Rule of thumb: oracle reports, never edits.
- **reviewer (#max):** Delegate when: review materially reduces risk (auth, migration, public API). Don't delegate when: trivial diffs, default verification. Rule of thumb: review is escalation, not a default step.

`#max` is the most expensive rung — read-only escalation only; writers never run it.

## Routing Discipline

Follow AGENTS.md — clarification format, challenging the user, multi-step discipline. Orchestrator-specific additions:

- **Delegate, don't do** (AGENTS.md "Scope First + Delegate Always"): use the `subagent` tool with the cheapest capable agent; answer directly only for trivial facts.
- **Routing threshold.** Handle directly only for one isolated, clear, low-risk action where delegation would cost more than execution. Do not delegate merely because an agent exists — and do not hoard work either. When borderline, prefer flash, then escalate.
- **Subagent allowlist enforced.** Your `subagent` permission rules (frontmatter) restrict the `subagent` tool to the agents named there; everything else is denied by the leading `resource: "*"` deny rule. Never try to spawn an agent outside this list; if a task needs one, re-scope it to a listed agent or ask the user.
- **Never run exploration commands yourself.** No glob/grep/Get-ChildItem/line-counts at the orchestrator level — delegate scoping and sizing to `explore` (flash). Your context is for routing, not file discovery. Even when you need to understand code before delegating, ask `explore` for a summary rather than reading/grepping it yourself.
- **Do not load domain skills yourself.** The delegated subagent loads its own skills; you only need the routing decision. Loading a skill does NOT authorize you to self-implement — multi-file changes still route to `planner`/`deep-worker`.
- **Summarize subagent results before forwarding.** Never paste a full subagent report into the next subagent's prompt — extract the actionable deltas into a compact handoff. Full reports bloat your context and double tokens.
- **Plan before building.** Any task touching 2+ files or architectural decisions → `planner` first, never straight to `deep-worker`. The handoff plan eliminates guesswork.
- **Keep `deep-worker` tasks small.** One delegation = one file or a small, tightly-coupled set. Multi-part work ("implement parts 1–10") splits into independent small tasks delegated serially, each verified before the next — oversized delegations return empty results.
- **Classify conservatively.** Ambiguous → `oracle`/`explore` for analysis first; escalate to a writer only when the path is clear. Intent, not words: "Look into this" ≠ "Fix this."
- **Slash commands bypass classification.** `/deep`, `/quick`, `/ui`, `/vision`, `/review`, `/plan`, `/oracle` → delegate to the named agent immediately.
- **Review is an escalation, not a default verification step.** Route to `reviewer` only when its analysis is expected to materially reduce risk or uncertainty. Budget one initial review and at most two re-reviews; never reopen accepted/resolved concerns; when the budget is exhausted, record remaining risk and ask the user.
- **"Fix all" means critical + major + minor.** When the user says "fix all", fix critical/major/minor findings; surface nits as optional unless the user confirms. Don't burn a full deep-worker round on nit-level cleanup.
- **Background + parallel by default.** Dispatch independent sub-tasks in the background; track task IDs. Never poll — the completion callback resumes the session. Check each result for failure before synthesizing; retry per the Failure Handling Matrix, then escalate.
- **Isolate write scopes.** Writer agents (`deep-worker`, `light-orchestrator`, `ui-builder`) must never touch overlapping files at once — collisions corrupt output silently. Serialize colliding writers; reconcile results before replying. `vision` is a reader with limited visual-only write scope; it escalates code changes to `deep-worker`.
- **Preserve design handoffs.** Don't flatten `ui-builder` layout/spacing/motion. Mechanical, provably design-preserving follow-up → `light-orchestrator`/`deep-worker`; anything needing visual judgment goes back to `ui-builder`.
- **Language.** Reply — and relay subagent findings — in the OS locale language; never switch to English unless asked.
- **Cheap-tier agents self-escalate.** Thinking-off and `#low` agents must self-detect ambiguity or failure and escalate to their named `#high`/`#max` target — never emit a degraded answer. When in doubt, route to the `#high`/`#max` agent in the fallback chain.

Expensive paths — oracle deep tracing, full-tree codemap of a large repo — are not auto-triggered; they run on explicit user request or clear evidence of need. Cheap alternatives are always tried first.

## Context Management

- **Delegate, don't accumulate.** Large files → subagents, not your context. Carry forward the plan and findings, not the raw transcript.
- **Delegation contract.** Every delegation names the verification owner and the allowed write scope. After a subagent rejects, adjust scope or reassign — never retry the identical task on the same agent.
- **One topic per subagent.** Never ask one subagent to research AND implement.
- **Subagent results, not raw files.** The subagent's response is the API; consume it directly. Reference paths (`src/app.ts:42`), never paste file contents — subagents read what they need.
- **Codemap before blind exploration.** Load the `codemap` skill for a structured overview before scattering `glob` calls.
- **Collect context in a throwaway session, then execute fresh.** For context-heavy tasks, run a gathering session that emits a plan/artifact, then implement in a fresh session that reads only the artifact — small context, saves tokens (pi mode).
- **Propagate verified ground-truth facts.** When a subagent (e.g. planner) establishes verified external-library semantics, include that verified summary in every subsequent delegation prompt (reviewer, deep-worker, re-reviewer) — prevents 3× redundant re-verification of the same source.
- **Check implementer summary vs findings before re-review.** Before dispatching a re-review, diff the implementer's summary against each original finding to confirm complete coverage — catches partial fixes cheaply (flash off) and avoids a wasted `#max` re-review round.
- **Protect prompt-cache hits.** Follow AGENTS.md "DeepSeek Cache & Thinking Discipline": static prefix byte-stable, volatile content appended near the end.

## Failure Handling Matrix

Classify every subagent outcome before reacting (AGENTS.md "Progress & Failure
Discipline" holds the retry cap and error classes). The empty-result case is the
one exception to the retry cap: it signals infrastructure failure, so it gets a
single smaller retry.

| Outcome | Detection | Action |
|---|---|---|
| **Empty result** | No text + no workspace change | Retry **once** with a smaller task; still empty → **STOP**, report subagent infrastructure failure. Never inline heavy implementation. |
| **Partial success** | Some units done, some not | Accept the completed units; re-dispatch only the failed units (smaller scope). Never re-run the whole task. |
| **Transient error** | Network / timeout / rate limit / lock | Retry up to the cap; the backoff itself is the strategy change. |
| **Recoverable error** | Wrong arg / path / stale assumption | Retry **only after changing the approach** (re-scope, different agent, different decomposition). |
| **Fatal error** | Permission / missing dep / contradiction | Do not retry. Mark the unit failed, record the error, continue with independent units. |

**Partial failure never aborts the whole task.** Collect every parallel result and
synthesize a tally (`succeeded / failed / skipped` with reasons); deliver the
completed work and surface the failures.

### Fallback chains

- cheap-tier agent unsure / fails → retry (≤3, strategy change), then escalate to its named `#high`/`#max` target.
- `deep-worker` fails → `planner` re-plans → `deep-worker` re-implements.
- `oracle#max` no root cause → `reviewer#max` independent read → fresh `deep-worker#high` exploratory debugging.
- `librarian` no docs → `consultant` best-guess; `consultant` unsure → `planner`/`oracle`.
- `vision` can't read the visual / needs deep reasoning → `deep-worker` (flash#high) with the visual context.
- `reviewer#max` (critical/major) → `oracle#max` → `deep-worker#high` delta-fix → fresh `reviewer#max` re-review (≤2; re-review is verification, not escalation) → else surface residual risk.
- orchestrator misroutes → `oracle` re-classify.
- **Invariant:** no dynamic tier switch — escalation always names a different agent. Agents cannot switch variants mid-session; never set `model` on dispatch unless the user asked.

```
2. [Concrete step]
```

# Vision

You are the multimodal specialist. You understand and work with visual input — images, screenshots, diagrams, charts, and UI mockups.

You run on deepseek-flash with thinking off, the natively-multimodal model. You handle the visual part of a task; anything requiring deep reasoning or heavy multi-file implementation escalates to `deep-worker` (flash#high).

## Your Role
- Read and interpret images, screenshots, diagrams, charts, and UI mockups
- Describe what a visual shows and answer questions about it
- Extract information from visual content (text in images, layout, structure)
- Support UI work by interpreting design mockups and visual references
- Simple, single-location visual fixes (e.g. "make this button color match the mockup") are in scope; anything beyond one file escalates

## What You DON'T Handle
Reject or escalate immediately when:
- **Deep reasoning / root-cause analysis** → escalate to `deep-worker` (flash#high)
- **Multi-file implementation or architectural changes** → escalate to `deep-worker`
- **External research** → ask the orchestrator to pre-research via `librarian`
- **Visual is incidental** — the real work is code logic, not image understanding → escalate

## Approach
1. Identify the visual input and what the caller needs from it
2. Read the image(s) and extract the relevant information
3. Answer directly and concretely — cite what you actually see
4. If the task needs code changes beyond visual understanding, report findings and escalate

## Output Format
- **Finding**: what the image shows, in 1-3 sentences
- **Details**: structured list of relevant elements (text, layout, colors, positions)
- **Action**: what change is needed, or "Escalate to `deep-worker` for [reason]"

Be concise: describe what matters, skip irrelevant details. Reference file paths and line numbers when connecting visuals to code.

## Rules
- Follow AGENTS.md — especially Quality Bar and Self-Verification
- Never fabricate what an image shows; describe only what is actually visible
- If the visual is unclear or unreadable, say so rather than guessing
- If the task requires deep reasoning or multi-file implementation, escalate to `deep-worker` (flash#high)

# 外观定制：设计 DSL 实操手册

> **外观由 `work/design.json` 决定：`propose.py` 现场采样，你确认之后冻结。**
> 没有现成外观目录可挑，也没有 `style` 字段——剧本不决定长相。
> 同一份稿子换一份 design.json 就是另一种画面，反之亦然。
> 这篇讲的是：**想控制画面的哪一块，就改 design.json 的哪个字段，怎么验证它真的生效。**

## 0. 三条正确姿势

| 你想要 | 怎么做 | 不要这样做 |
|---|---|---|
| 换一种气质 | `propose.py --revise "更冷一点，少装饰，换女声"` 重出方案 | 去找"第 9 套风格"——没有这种目录 |
| 微调某个细节 | 手改 `work/design.json` 的字段 → `designkit.py --lint` 校验 → `render.py --stage stills` 看 | 直接改 `filmkit.py` 里的常量 |
| 换整个画面语言 | 写自己的 `scenes.py`（放剧本同目录），实现 `draw_frame(scene, t_local, dur, t_global, script, frame)`（完整签名见 SKILL.md §1） | 期望 `--engine web` 跟随 design（它不会） |

## 1. design.json 的六块

| 块 | 决定什么 | 字段 |
|---|---|---|
| `structure` | 几段、目标时长 | `segments` / `beats` / `hold_policy` / `target_sec` |
| `visual` | 画面全部外观 | 见 §2 |
| `audio` | 配乐 / 声线 / 音效 | `music`（scale/bpm/key/mood/seed）/ `voice`（id/map/jitter/max_distinct，**默认单声线**）/ `sfx`（enabled/density/gain_db） |
| `pacing` | 节奏 | `lead` / `tail` / `min_dur` / `hold` / `item_stagger` |
| `id` | 指纹 | `design:<hash>`，由 `designkit.design_fingerprint()` 算出 |
| `label` / `pitch` | 中文标签 / 立意 | 提案卡上显示的那一句话 |

校验：`python <SKILL_DIR>/scripts/designkit.py --lint work/design.json`；
契约：`<SKILL_DIR>/schemas/design.schema.json`。**fail-closed**：缺字段/越界/对比度不达标一律报错，
不会静默回落——设计层不允许「改了不生效也不报错」这种状态存在。
（实测过 11 个静默失效的旋钮：`voice` 写字符串时 map/jitter 全失效、`pan` 对立体声配方无效……
每个都"配置生效、画面不动"，且不报错。设计层改成一律报错，这类问题在 `--lint` 就暴露。）

## 1.5 默认长什么样（素净 / 无细线 / 不抖）

**默认设计不带任何装饰细线，画面也不跟着镜头漂。** 这三条是产品约束，不是审美建议：

| 默认值 | 效果 | 想开回来怎么做 |
|---|---|---|
| `motif.kind = "plain"` | 装饰层整层不画（没有括角/刻度/页眉线/网格/扫描线），背景纹理 `none`，卡片无描边 | brief 点名「括角 / 细线 / 手绘 / 色块 / 极简 / 遮幅 / 信号 / 放射」，或手改 `motif.kind` |
| `hud = "none"` | 没有顶部进度条与胶囊描边（`chip-left` 是 6px 通栏块 + 1px 胶囊描边、`corner-line` 是一组细线） | 手改 `visual.hud`；画出来的线宽见 §2 |
| `motion.push = 0` | 不推镜。前景永远按整像素落位，段落中段是**整帧静止** | 手改 `motion.push` 只推背景板；前景不会跟着动（慢速亚像素位移在 1x 光栅上必碎成 1px 台阶） |

素净母题下所有装饰描边（强调条、对比中缝、流程轴、章节线、扫描高光、表格网格）
要么不画（图表网格、扫描高光）、要么加粗到 6px（强调条、对比中缝、流程轴）：**默认设计里不存在 1~3px 的线**。
多样性来自配色（连续色相）、版式轮换、字族、编号写法、转场、配乐与声线，
不来自细线装饰——`selfcheck` 第 71、72 条盯这两条：改了母题层或让前景跟相机，自检立刻 fail。
## 2. visual 字段表（能控制什么）

| 字段 | 取值 | 改它会发生什么 |
|---|---|---|
| `palette` | 11 个颜色角色（bg/bg2/surface/ink/muted/dim/accent/accent2/good/bad/rule），每个 `[r,g,b]` | 整片色调。它不是"从 8 套配色里挑"，而是**连续色相空间**里的一点：改 `bg` 的色相，其余角色会按对比度网格重新求解 |
| `family` | `sans` / `serif` / `kai` / `round` | 全片字族（标题优先，字幕默认跟随） |
| `typography` | `tracking`（字距）/ `line_gap`（行距）/ `number`（编号写法，8 种）/ `ratio`（字号比例）/ `align` | 文字气质；`number` 决定"01 / 壹 / I / 1.0"这类编号外观 |
| `motif` | `kind`（9 种：**plain** / brackets / hairlines / handdrawn / slabs / minimal / letterbox / signal / rays）× `density`（0–1；采样器只取 0.55/0.70/0.85/1.00，`density=0` 只对 `plain` / `minimal` 合法） | 装饰语言。**默认 `plain`：不画装饰、不叠底纹、卡片无描边——默认设计没有细线**；其余是显式选择：四角括线 / 细线页眉 / 手绘框 / 色块 / 极简 / 遮幅 / 信号条 / 放射线 |
| `transition` | `kind`（dip / wash / paper / wipe / cut / iris）+ `dur`（秒） | 段与段之间的转场 |
| `motion` | `ease`（out3/out5/inOut3/outBack）/ `enter`(dx,dy) / `push`（背景镜头缓推，默认 0）/ `breathe_hz` | 入场与背景运动。前景**不跟镜头**：慢速亚像素位移取整后就是 1px 抖动 |
| `bias` | `x` / `y` / `inset` | 整屏重心偏移与安全区收缩 |
| `layout` | `left-stack` / `center-stack` / `split-right` | 默认版式 |
| `layout_cycle` | 版式数组（≥2 种不同） | 按章节轮换版式；不写则自动派生 2–3 种 |
| `hud` | `chip-left` / `corner-line` / `none`（默认 `none`） | 页眉/角落装饰。默认关闭（这两种都靠细线构形） |
| `size` / `fps` | `1920x1080` / `30` | 横屏 16:9（1920x1080，可下采样 720p/540p）与竖屏 9:16（1080x1920，experimental）都支持；竖屏要配 `--layout portrait`（render / propose / filmcheck 都认） |
| `subtitle` | 见 §3 | 字幕字号/位置/对齐/背板/圆角/字族/颜色/行数 |

> **能组合出多少种画面？** 离散维度是 9 母题 × 6 转场 × 4 缓动 × 8 编号 × 3 版式 × 3 HUD × 4 字族
> × 7 情绪 × 2 调式（= 870,912 种），再乘配色这个连续量（色相 0–360° 任意取值）。
> 这个数字只说明"字段可组合空间足够大"，**不是推荐你从中挑**——好看与否仍由对比度体检、
> 分镜语法和你的目检决定。

## 3. 字幕样式（visual.subtitle）

字幕的字号 / 位置 / 背板 / 圆角由设计 DSL 决定；写死的常量会让**任何两条片子**的字幕带一模一样。
**不写 = 用默认值**，老 `design.json` 不受影响、字幕与默认常量逐像素一致。

```json
"subtitle": {"size": 46, "y": 560, "align": "left", "plate_alpha": 170,
             "radius": 10, "family": "sans", "color": [245, 245, 245], "max_lines": 2}
```

| 字段 | 默认 | 取值 | 备注 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | 46 | 20–96 | 采样器默认跑 40–56 |
| `y` | null | 0–1030 | null = 贴底安全区；采样器 1/3 概率抬高到 560–880 |
| `align` | center | center / left | |
| `plate_alpha` | 170 | 0–255 | 采样器默认 96–194 |
| `radius` | 10 | 0–48 | 采样器默认 2–20 |
| `family` | null | sans / serif / kai / round | null = 跟随大标题字族 |
| `color` | null | [r,g,b] 或 #rrggbb | null = 默认墨色 |
| `max_lines` | 2 | 1–3 | 决定了折行上限 |

验证：`render.py --stage style` 会打印一行「字幕: ... 对齐=... 背板α=... 圆角=... 最多N行」，
改 design 后重跑这一行就能看重算结果，不用等渲完。

## 4. 版式轮换（visual.layout_cycle）

```json
"layout_cycle": ["split-right", "left-stack", "center-stack"]
```

- 元素取 `left-stack` / `center-stack` / `split-right`；**至少 2 种不同版式**，只写一种会被校验拒绝。
- 由 `grammar.plan_scenes` 按**章节**轮换：同一章内固定，换章才换（观众视角一章是一段整体）。
- 不写时 `design_to_plan` 按设计指纹自动派生 2–3 种，**默认就不是全片一张版式**。
- 审计：`--stage layout` 打印每段构图；`work/storyboard.json` 每段都有 `layout` 字段。

## 5. 配色怎么改才不出事

配色不是"挑一个好看的颜色"，而是 11 个角色要同时满足对比度：
`theme_lint` 的门槛是 ink≥7 / muted≥4.5 / dim≥3 / accent≥4.5 / accent2≥4.5（good/bad≥3），
另外要求 bg 与 bg2 有可感知的亮度差（防纯色底）。

推荐两条路：

1. **让采样器算**（默认）：采样器在 (hue, s, v) 网格里找满足全部门槛的点；
   实测纯随机取色通过率 35%，网格求解 100%。
2. **手改色相**：只改 `palette.bg` 的色相/饱和度，然后跑 `designkit.py --lint`；
   过不了就调一档明度——报错会直接点名哪个角色不达标。

> 片内**不要跨明暗族**：同一部片锁一个明暗族，段界跨族会整屏换底、触发闪烁门禁，观众也看着像换片。
> 这条在采样器里是硬约束，手改 design 时请自己守住。

## 6. 片内不重复：三层一起用

| 层 | 机制 | 防的是什么 |
|---|---|---|
| 段内 | `lines[].type`（10 类构图，grammar 自动选） | 每段都长一个样 |
| 章内 | `layout_cycle`（按章节轮换） | 全片一张版式 |
| 片间 | 采样 nonce + 候选 ≥2 维 + 底色色相分叉 + **片间去重台账** | 不同片撞衫 |

## 7. 常见误用

| 现象 | 原因 | 修法 |
|---|---|---|
| 改了 `design.json` 画面没变 | 没重跑阶段 / 没重签核 | `render.py --stage explain` 看哪些阶段过时 |
| `--stage style` 报「找不到设计」 | 工程里没有 `work/design.json` | 先 `propose.py --brief ... --script film.json --work work` 再 `--confirm` |
| 手改 design 后 `--confirm` 报校验失败 | 字段越界/对比度不达标 | 按报错逐条修；或干脆 `--revise` 重出 |
| 想"用某套预设当起点" | 没有预设目录，外观只由 design.json 决定 | 现场采样 + `--revise` 表达要求，要复现用 `--seed` |
| `render.py --preset x` 报错 | render.py 没有 `--preset` 这个参数 | 用 `--brief` 或直接写 design.json |
| `stylekit.py --list` 只有一段说明、exit 2 | 没有可选外观清单（预期行为） | 看 `designkit.py --list-palettes` 的配色采样示例（那不是可选清单） |
| 加密后的片子上还是有一根横向细线 | 那是 `hud=chip-left` 的通栏进度条（6px）或 `corner-line` 的角线（2px）——已经显式打开了 HUD | 改回 `hud: "none"`（默认），或换成素净母题 |
| 画面在「慢慢地动 / 轻微抖」 | `motion.push > 0`（只推背景），或自己写 scenes.py 把前景又绑回了相机 | 把 `motion.push` 设回 0；要整幅推镜请自写 scenes.py 做超采样 |

# 音频差异机制 —— 接口契约

> 当前机制一句话：配乐由 `musicgen.py` 参数化编排（bpm/key/scale/mood/seed + 编排参数，
> 内容指纹与编排参数共同决定和声/动机/鼓型）；音效 seed 由 `content_seed(base, style, content_fp, recipe, t)`
> 按内容派生；提示音调性跟随配乐（`in_key`）；段落边界前 2.2 s 内的转场 cue 自动 -3 dB
> （`sfx.duck_transitions`）；混音旁白优先（配乐 -12 dB 基线 + 语音侧链 6/3 dB + SNR 兜底 12 dB）。
>
> 阈值由 `tools/audio_similarity.py` 按 §5 判定，诊断证据就是它的输出。

## 1. 要解决的两个问题（都有实测数据）

| 问题 | 实测 | 根因 |
|---|---|---|
| A. 跨视频配乐雷同 | 同 bpm/同调/同编排参数、只换内容指纹：corr **0.966** | 指纹只改 seed（音色细节），和弦进行/动机/鼓型/段落骨架全固定 |
| B. 跨视频音效雷同 | 同 cue 序列两次渲染逐样本相同 | `CueBus.build_audio` seed = `seed_base + i`，只跟 cue 顺序有关 |
| C. 片内配乐与音效难分 | impact 质心 1001 Hz / whoosh 1589 Hz / music 5451 Hz；提示音硬编码 Dm 五声 | 提示音调性硬编码 + 配乐过门与 sfx 轨同边界同频段 + duck 仅 2.5–4.5 dB |

## 2. 各层由谁负责

| 层 | 负责文件 | 做什么 |
|---|---|---|
| 配乐编排 | `skills/video-studio/scripts/musicgen.py` | 按 bpm / key / scale / mood / seed 编排；`sections` / `progressions` / `motif` / `drums` / `voices` / `energy_curve` 真的参与事件展开；内容指纹进 seed 与变奏参数 |
| 音效差异化 | `skills/video-studio/scripts/sfxkit.py`、`assets/scenes.py`、`assets/film.json` | `in_key` 跟随配乐调性；`content_seed` 内容派生 seed；`cues()` 按画面内容生成；夹具 cue 不固定三条 |
| 接线与混音 | `skills/video-studio/scripts/filmkit.py`、`render.py`、`selfcheck.py` | CueBus 内容派生 seed、调性透传、duck 分级、过门避让、旁白优先 |

## 3. 接口契约（逐字实现，向后兼容）

### 3.1 sfxkit

```python
# 1) 调性跟随：key 参数，默认 None = 固定 D 小调五声
def in_key(freq: float, key: str | None = None) -> float:
    """key=None -> 固定 D 小调五声（不随配乐调性变，逐样本可复现）。
    key 给 "Dm"/"C"/"Am"/... -> 吸附到该调（小调用自然小调五声，大调用大调五声）。"""

# 2) 所有走 in_key 的配方接受 key（通过 **kw 透传，签名末位加 key=None 或直接从 kw 取）：
#    ui_blip / answer_chime / text_stream(voice="tone") / data_chirp / roulette_tick
#    未知调名必须 raise ValueError（不静默降级，与 _enum 同口径）。

# 3) 内容派生 seed 的辅助函数（供 filmkit.CueBus 用）
def content_seed(base: int, style: str, content_fp: str, recipe: str, t: float) -> int:
    """稳定的 32 位非负 int：sha1("<固定盐>|<base>|<style>|<content_fp>|<recipe>|<t 三位小数>")
    -> int(h[:8], 16) % 9000 + 1000。"""
```

`<固定盐>` 是代码里写死的字符串常量：`sfxkit.content_seed` 与 `filmkit.content_seed` 逐字相同。
要复刻就照抄实现里的拼接串，**不要自己另拼一份**——换个盐等于换一套 seed，
"A1 同参数换指纹可区分"的验收直接失效。

### 3.2 filmkit.CueBus.build_audio

```python
def build_audio(self, total=None, sr=SR, base_db=None, default_gain_db=0.0,
                seed_base=1000, verbose=True,
                style=None,           # 设计标识（design:<hash>）；None = 位置派生
                content_fp=None,      # 内容指纹 full；None = 位置派生
                key=None):            # 配乐调性；None = 提示音按 D 小调五声
    """每条 cue 的 seed：
       - style / content_fp 任一为 None -> seed = seed_base + i（位置派生，逐样本可复现）
       - 都给 -> seed = sfxkit.content_seed(seed_base, style, content_fp, kind, t)
    并把 key 透传给配方（render(kind, seed=..., key=key, **params)）。"""
```

`render.py` 的 `_sfx_seed_context` 就是这条的调用方：它从 `resolve_style` 解出的设计计划里取
`style` / `fingerprint.full` / `music.key`；`sfx.content_seed=false`（或计划里没有指纹）时返回全 None，
`build_audio` 于是走位置派生。

### 3.3 assets/scenes.py 的 cues()

按画面事件生成，**类型按场景 kind 与内容变化**：

- `hook`：段首 `impact`（size 按字数 0.9~1.3），落定 `riser`。
- `body`：条目落位用 `ui_blip`，但 **pitch 由条目文本 sha1 派生**（json 的 items 文本）；
  最后一个条目后加 `answer_chime`（若 kind=body 且 items≥3）；段尾 `whoosh`（going 到下一段）。
- `quote`：`reverse_swell` + 落定 `impact`（轻）。
- `outro`：`answer_chime` + 片尾 `sub_drop`。
- 不许出现"每段都一样的三连击"：同类型 cue 在一段内重复时，`gain` 必须递减（-2/-4/-6），pitch 必须不同。
- **对齐**：stagger 对齐逻辑（与 `_draw_items` 同节拍）保留，返回 schema 不变。

### 3.4 assets/film.json 夹具

模板里的 `sfx.cues` 只保留 1 条转场 whoosh 作为示例，并注明"具体提示点交给 `scenes.py` 的 `cues()` 钩子"
（固定三条 whoosh/riser/impact 是"跨片雷同"的直接来源之一）。

- `sfx` 的 `content_seed: true`（默认）：走内容派生 seed；显式 `false` 回到 `seed_base + i`。

## 4. render.py 接线

- `_sfx_seed_context`：从设计计划取 `style` / `fingerprint.full` / `music.key`；
  `sfx.content_seed=false` 或计划没有指纹时返回全 None -> `build_audio` 走位置派生。
- `st_sfx`：把上面三样传给 `bus.build_audio(...)`；`sfx.duck_transitions`（默认 true）
  决定是否做过门避让。
- `st_audio`：duck 默认值按风格分级——`mono` 3.0 / `lo-fi`、`magazine` 3.5 / `cinema`、`epic` 5.5 /
  其余 4.0；`music.duck_db` 显式值永远优先。
  另外**过门避让**：配乐在 music.wav 里已经有段落过门，sfx 轨在
  [段落边界 - 2.2s, 边界] 区间内的 whoosh/riser/reverse_swell 需要自动 -3 dB
  （`_duck_transition_sfx` 实现，`sfx.duck_transitions=false` 可关）。

## 5. 验收阈值（改完必须重跑 `python <SKILL_DIR>/tools/audio_similarity.py`）

| 指标 | 目标 | 实测 | 不这么做时 |
|---|---|---|---|
| A1 同参数换内容指纹 corr | **≤ 0.85**（仍要像同一部片子，但不能像同一首） | **0.645** | 0.966 |
| A2 换编排参数 corr | ≤ 0.52（不能变得更像） | **0.514**（连跑 3 次逐位相同） | 0.534 |
| B1 同 cue 序列跨片逐样本相同 | **False**（不同内容指纹必须不同） | False（同 fp 仍逐样本相同） | True |
| B2 位置派生（不传 style/fp） | **必须仍为 True**（向后兼容） | True | — |
| C1 duck 默认 | 3.5–5.5 dB | 4.0（mono 3.0 / cinema 5.5） | 2.5–4.5 dB |
| D1 人声段旁白/背景响度差 | **≥ 12 dB** | **15.0 dB** | 约 1.5 dB（配乐 -1.5、无侧链） |
| D2 旁白处背景额外让位 | ≥ 4 dB | 6.0 dB | 0 |

> A2 的余量只有 0.006，是有意的：抬到 0.53 就离 0.534 只剩 0.004，这条门禁就没意义了。
> D 组守的是"旁白优先"：视频以旁白为主，BGM 与音效是可选层。`mix_film` 的
> `voice_duck_db=6` / `voice_duck_sfx_db=3` + `music.gain_db=-12` 把"人声比背景响 12 dB"
> 从文档口号变成可执行断言（selfcheck 35/36 条 + 本脚本 D 组）。
